paper.title: Equivalence of Context and Parameter Updates in Modern Transformer Blocks

claims.scope: One full Gemma block/token plus five seeded toy trials and negative controls.
All 26 sequential Gemma layers for one target history and token.
40 actual-class architecture trials with topology and assumption controls.
Pinned naive-bfloat16 protocol is 100/100, not the paper's exact 87.5%.
Stable bfloat16 lowers logit error but does not improve token agreement over 100/100 naive agreement.
Eight named Transformer architecture forms pass at reduced deterministic widths.

limitations: This is a scoped finite and architecture audit, not a complete theorem, benchmark, or universal hardware reproduction.
C4/C5 are protocol-scoped precision boundaries, not universal refutations.
